column1: # Coral for Terrain's warm lagoons and reefs (Ronald approved; Terrain places the blocks, Plants wires the coral plants). Seen through 1-2 blocks of shallow bright water: a little warmer and more saturated than land. Same texture on all faces, 3 random variants each (_vN -> <name>/N.png).

column3: brain_coral_block|cube|Brain coral block: a living brain coral surface filling the square, warm pink-mauve (#6e3048 #94445e #b85c78 #d67c96 #eea4b8) in thick rounded meandering ridges 2-3 px wide separated by deep winding grooves (#4e2034), like a maze, soft light from the top left, seamless
column4: brain_coral_block_v1@-|cube|The same brain coral, variant 2: the same colours and ridge width, the maze winding differently, seamless
column5: brain_coral_block_v2@-|cube|The same brain coral, variant 3: the same colours, different meanders, one slightly paler patch, seamless
column6: brain_coral_block_v3@-|cube|The same brain coral, variant 4: the same colours, different meanders, seamless

column3: staghorn_coral_block|cube|Staghorn coral block: a dense thicket of thick branching coral antlers filling the square, warm ochre-orange to peach (#6a3a1c #94562a #bc7a3c #da9e58 #f0c486) with pale growing tips (#f8dcb0), the branches 3-4 px thick crossing at angles, the gaps between them deep shadow in a dark brown-purple (#3a2028), opaque, light from the top left, seamless
column4: staghorn_coral_block_v1@-|cube|The same staghorn coral, variant 2: the same colours, branches crossing differently, seamless
column5: staghorn_coral_block_v2@-|cube|The same staghorn coral, variant 3: the same colours, different branches, seamless
column6: staghorn_coral_block_v3@-|cube|The same staghorn coral, variant 4: the same colours, different branches, seamless

column3: porites_coral_block|cube|Porites coral block: a lumpy rock-like coral, rounded knobs and lobes 6-10 px across, ochre-tan (#5e4a2e #7e6640 #9e8456 #bca070 #d4bc8c) with a faint violet tinge in the hollows (#6a5060), its surface covered in tiny pores 1 px, light from the top left, reads as living rock, seamless
column4: porites_coral_block_v1@-|cube|The same porites coral, variant 2: the same colours and knobs, different lumps, seamless
column5: porites_coral_block_v2@-|cube|The same porites coral, variant 3: the same colours, different lumps, seamless
column6: porites_coral_block_v3@-|cube|The same porites coral, variant 4: the same colours, different lumps, seamless

column1: # The coral plants (Plants wires them: water-logged cross plants, own colours, one tile each). BLOCK_LIKE: seagrass,kelp,<the coral blocks>

column3: staghorn_coral|plant|Staghorn coral (Acropora cervicornis) standing on the sea floor: upright branching antlers 3 px thick forking two or three times, tan-ochre (#7a4e24 #a06a34 #c48c4c #dcac6c) with pale cream growing tips (#f4dcb0), about 24 px tall, 22 px wide, the same palette as the staghorn coral block
column4: elkhorn_coral|plant|Elkhorn coral (Acropora palmata): a short trunk at the bottom spreading into broad FLATTENED antlers like moose antlers, mustard-ochre (#7a5a1c #a07a2a #c49c3c #dcbc5c) with paler edges (#ecd88c), wide and low, about 18 px tall, 28 px wide
column5: finger_coral|plant|Finger coral (Porites porites): a clump of stubby lumpy upright fingers 3-4 px thick with rounded tips, pale violet-grey shading to ochre at the base (#5e4a58 #7e6a7a #9e8c9a #bcae9a #c8a870), tiny pores, about 16 px tall, 20 px wide
column6: sea_fan|plant|A sea fan (Gorgonia ventalina): one flat lacy fan rising from a short stalk, a fine net of purple branches (#4a1e5a #6a2e7e #8e48a2 #b070c4) with small holes between them (magenta), the outline round and wavy, about 26 px tall, 24 px wide

column3: sea_rod|plant|Sea rods (Plexaura, a soft coral): four or five soft upright rods 2-3 px thick rising from a base and forking once, brown-purple (#4e2e3a #6a3e4c #8a5462 #a8707c) with fuzzy pale polyps along them (#d8c0b8), about 26 px tall
column4: turtle_grass|plant|Turtle grass (Thalassia testudinum), a lagoon seagrass: a clump of broad flat ribbon blades 3 px wide (never thinner) rising from the bottom edge, bright fresh green (#3e6e2a #568e36 #74ae46 #92c858), slightly curved, rounded tips, a few with tan tips (#c4b47a), about 22 px tall
